title: Welcome to the Post Office

slides.title: Meet Pim
slides.text: Pim the owl runs the post office in Netville. Every day Pim carries letters and messages between the houses. Keeping them safe is Pim's whole job.
slides.alt: Pim opens the Netville map: houses, roads and the first message waiting to be delivered.

slides.title: Your world too
slides.text: Netville is a story, but the post is real. The games you play, the photos you send and the videos you watch all travel as packets on real roads. Real tricksters send real fake messages too, and what you learn here protects the real you.
slides.alt: Packets are on the roads of Netville, each carrying its number, so the far end can rebuild the message in order.

slides.title: Letters nobody wrote
slides.text: This morning the post sack held a surprise. Some letters were never written by the senders named on them. The culprit is the Magpie, the post office pest: it slips in fakes and collects shiny secrets. Shiny secrets are private facts and mailbox keys.
slides.alt: Spot the Trick opens its first message card: friendly words on the surface, and clues hiding in the text.

slides.title: Shiny or safe?
slides.text: Some post is fine to share, and some must stay private. Sort these the way a Cyber Defender would.
steps: your school and class: shiny secret
a joke for everyone: safe post
a drawing of a rainbow: safe post
a hello card for a friend: safe post
slides.alt: The sharing sort: cards to split into Share and Keep Private, from favorite animals to passphrases.

words.means: a person who keeps people and messages safe
words or a picture sent from one person to another
only for the people it is meant for, not for everyone
something fake that tries to fool you

slides.title: Six stamps, real jobs
slides.text: Each stamp matches your real day. Roadwise guards the packets behind your games and videos; Keykeeper guards your passphrases; Private guards what you share. Trickspotter spots fake messages, Kind Screen keeps chats kind, and Shield stacks layers of protection.
slides.alt: Escape the Post Office: six trick locks guard the sorting room door, one for each Defender stamp, and none is open yet.

slides.title: Your new job
slides.text: Pim is hiring you as a Cyber Defender. Every step works the same way: story slides first, then words to know, a quick check, and a mission. Your first stamp is waiting in the next unit.
slides.alt: Packet Post's title screen: Pim the owl at the Netville post office. Deliver every packet. Keep every secret.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: There is no game this time. Open the course map, find the six stamps, and say hello to each one. Your first stamp is waiting in the next unit.
slides.alt: Many Roads: the town map offers more than one road between the same houses, and a closed road is not the end.

talk: Think of one thing you sent, posted or played online this week. Which stamp would have guarded it, and how?
